mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my interior home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, look for experience, strong communication skills, and a portfolio of completed projects. Verify their licensing and insurance. Request references and speak with past clients about their satisfaction and project management. A good contractor provides clear contracts, detailed timelines, and transparent pricing.
